title: Events alert — 2026-11-02
body:
Just landed: Kioxia −17% in Tokyo today after flat Q2 guidance — read-across to MU, SNDK, SK Hynix, STX/WDC. Tonight (~22:15 Berlin / 16:15 ET): Fabrinet, Williams.

Tomorrow, Tue Nov 3, is the core:
• US midterms all day; results overnight into Wednesday Berlin. Repricing risk: AI-datacenter/energy policy, China chip rules.
• 12:30 Berlin (6:30 ET): Eaton, consensus EPS ~$3.54 on ~$8.48B revenue; datacenter orders are the tell. Talen pre-market (EPS ~$8.56).
• 22:15 Berlin (4:15 ET): AMD — consensus $1.94–1.95 EPS, ~$13.1B revenue. Decides whether Friday's SOX −7.2% was Intel-specific. SMCI (pre-announced $18.5–19.5B; options imply ±13%), Arista, Astera also report.

Sleeves: power must hold after Vertiv's +16.5%; semis face a binary; keep the 15% cash sleeve parked until Wednesday. Arm/Coherent follow Wed; Nvidia Nov 25.

Sources: web search 2026-11-02 (Yahoo/TipRanks, EarningsWhispers, boerse-express).
